inspection.composition: Small oval leaves on slender twigs form an overlapping thicket along the right and lower margins and run off both edges, so the foliage continues past the frame like the other animal cards; centre and upper-left stay empty.
inspection.material: Generated raster material: low-chroma gray-sage foliage with a matte painted finish and soft brushed edges, not photographic sharpness.
inspection.edges: Single complete canvas; the motif deliberately leaves the canvas at the right and lower edges rather than stopping on a straight line; no seamless-repeat claim.
inspection.themes: Light and dark generated separately on the recorded paper tokens with gray-sage detail.
